full_judgment: "Following this decision of the Privy Council, different High Courts of the Sub-continent allowed restitution in the case of reversal of orders in exercise of their discretion under section 151 of the Code". Although facts involved in cited case is distinguishable from the facts of instant case, the principle enunciated by their Lordships will have full application in this case. Therefore, there is no manner of doubt that the parties will not be involved in a fresh litigation in the event of success of opposite party in Title Suit No. 239 of 1985 and the question of par- ties being involved in separate litigation in the event of success in Title suit No. 239 of 1985 does not arise.
